what_it_does: This work integrates multiple task runtime systems (software frameworks for scheduling and running parallel work) to better support workflows that mix both AI and traditional high-performance computing (HPC) tasks. The current standard job submission system (Slurm) cannot keep up with the rapid, dynamic task submission demands of hybrid AI-HPC pipelines and doesn't understand heterogeneous compute resources well. The solution connects hierarchical resource management across three runtime systems to schedule and track work more efficiently.
